classification: post-hoc full-factorial alpha-parameter audit around frozen R360; research-only
hypothesis: The R360 B-sleeve exit should remain effective across adjacent fade-change, holding and stop-loss settings instead of depending on one selected combination.

fixed_construction.stock_strategy: R360 B-sleeve scoring, filters, 10 positions and 2x execution costs
fixed_construction.portfolio: same monthly risk-parity A/B/C sleeves, 10% C cap, 15% joint equity target, 60-day overlay lookback, 15% overlay target and one-third equity-weight cap

decision_rules: Run all 27 cells; do not stop after a favourable or unfavourable cell.
Do not select the best cell and do not replace R360 based on this audit.
The centre cell (5 days, 20 holding days, -20% stop) must reconstruct the frozen R360 portfolio metrics before any grid conclusion is accepted.
A parameter is qualified for this neighbourhood only if overall and every marginal-slice pass rate clear the preregistered thresholds.
No leverage, order, paper target or production change is permitted.
known_limits: The grid is adjacent, not exhaustive; values outside 3-10 days, 10-30 holding days and -15% to -25% stops are not covered.
Only the realistic 2x cost case is rerun for all 27 cells; 5x remains a centre-point diagnostic.
The current industry snapshot is backfilled and is not point-in-time data.
Historical HS300 membership and ETF adjusted-price limitations remain.
The 27 cells are correlated and are not independent multiple-testing trials.
